ranges.independent_lifecycle: Both stock state-3 callers dispatch ECX game state with no stack args. GOG advances the simulation clock, dispatches both world queues, executes state/world updates and refreshes player panels before returning. The manager calls the entire unchanged GOG update before its existing private panel refresh; Steam network/diagnostic branches are not transplanted.
